patterns: what type of engineer am i
entries.answer: Engineering is applying science and mathematics to build something that does what it must, within constraints of cost, time, safety and law. That last constraint is what separates it from a science degree, since a perfect solution that cannot be built or maintained is not an engineering result. Branches are usually named after the industry rather than the method, so civil, mechanical, electrical and chemical are different industries that happen to share an approach.

patterns: is design the same as drawing
entries.answer: Engineering design is the process of turning a requirement into something that can be built, and it is iterative in a way that most people underestimate. Each pass exposes constraints the first one missed, so a design that looks finished after one drawing is a design that has not been tested against reality. Professionals write down why a choice was made rather than only what was chosen, since the reason is what lets a later engineer change it safely.

patterns: what does a mechanical engineer do
entries.answer: A mechanical engineer works with anything that moves, from engines and gearboxes to robotics and air conditioning, and the work is a balance between strength, cost and manufacturability. The defining skill is not mechanics but knowing which compromise to accept, since a stronger design that cannot be produced at a reasonable price has failed. The field changed markedly with computer-aided design, which made complex shapes possible to specify but moved the bottleneck to manufacturing.

patterns: is licensure required in the philippines
entries.answer: Professional licensure in the Philippines is what converts an engineering degree into the legal right to practise, and it is a separate requirement with its own exam. Many graduates work first under supervision, taking the board exam only once they have the hours the profession requires, which is why the exam is commonly taken a few years after graduating. The arrangement exists because the degree certifies that you learned the theory and the licence certifies that you can be held responsible for work.
